Dear prado team,

I am writing to apply for the Social Media & Community Marketeer position. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in social media coordination, content creation, and community engagement, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to prado's growth across multiple brands and markets.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO and content for client websites, and I have built and maintained WordPress sites with integrated social media. My own project, mirook.com, involved creating and scheduling posts, engaging with followers, and analyzing performance—skills directly relevant to this role. I am comfortable with Meta, Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube, and I enjoy adapting tone of voice to different audiences.

I am organized, proactive, and eager to learn, and I am fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 and improving. I would love to bring my technical and creative mix to prado's team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear prado team,

I am excited to apply for the Social Media & Community Marketeer position at prado. Your mission to create invisible home technology for the world's best architects resonates with my passion for blending technical precision with creative communication. With a background in digital marketing, web development, and content creation, I am eager to contribute to your growing ecosystem across Europe, North America, and the Middle East.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites. This has honed my ability to craft engaging posts that align with brand guidelines and drive organic visibility. On my own project, mirook.com, I have directly managed social media accounts, created and scheduled content, and engaged with the community—experience that mirrors the daily responsibilities of this role. I am comfortable with Meta, Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube, and I am quick to learn new platforms like TikTok and Pinterest.

I am particularly drawn to prado's collaborative environment and the opportunity to work with US content creators and performance marketers. My technical background in SEO and GEO, combined with my social media coordination skills, allows me to approach content with a data-informed mindset, monitoring engagement and identifying opportunities for improvement. I am organized, proactive, and thrive in fast-paced settings, as demonstrated by my ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.

Fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 and improving, I am ready to adapt my tone of voice across brands and markets. I am eager to bring my enthusiasm and skills to prado, and I am confident that my blend of technical and creative abilities will help grow your social media presence and community engagement.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
